verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo agents (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-12) are described as turning issues into merge requests, remediating vulnerabilities, and reviewing code, with orchestration/guardrails, and docs mention a suite of AI-native features (gitlab-docs-15). However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing copy without hands-on confirmation of task delegation UX or independent corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of the AI assistant actually completing delegated tasks, and concrete detail on the delegation interface/workflow rather than high-level marketing claims.
